newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-STICH PULLS OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-STICH PULLS OUT OF FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: Michael Stich said on Thursday he would not play in the French Open.
Stich, beaten in last year's final by Russian Yevgeny Kafelnikov, made the announcement after losing 6-1 6-3 to Spain's Albert Costa at the World Team Cup.
The 1991 Wimbledon champion said a nagging shoulder injury had worsened to the point where his serve had been reduced to about 40 percent.
Stich, ranked 27th in the world, joins Andre Agassi, Boris Becker and Todd Martin as name players to pull out of French open which begins on Monday.
